Ahobala_Sūri
of Samudrāla family; son of Nṛsiṁha an. grandson of Ahobala; pupil of Śaṅkarānanda an. Svayamprakāśayati.
--Āpastambaśrautasūtravṛtti-Yājñikasarvasva. Baroda 7765.

--Yatirājavijaya campū.

Ahobala_Ācārya

--Vākyārtharatna with own C. Tātparyaprakāśikā called Suvarṇamudrā (Mīm. Prābhākara). Q. Bhavanātha. Adyar II. p. 129b. Adyar D.
. Mysore I. p. 416 (3 mss.). II. p. 21.

); successor of Parāṅkuśayati (of the Ahobalam Mutt).

). See J. of the Andhra His.. Res. Soc. XIII. p.. I. p. 19.
